title: The Luminous Sounding
description: A striking 16:10 landscape inside a submerged Roman harbor archaeology chamber at blue-black twilight: intact stone arches and fallen columns recede through clear water, suspended diving bells glow faintly, coral and silt soften the ancient masonry, and an illuminated worktable holds brushes, calipers, pottery fragments, and labeled-but-unreadable excavation tags. In the lower-right, Space Ghost—muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, red power bands—stands on a narrow inspection gantry, solemnly measuring a tiny amphora with an absurdly oversized brass caliper while two historically dressed divers continue their careful excavation nearby. His cape drifts underwater, the only overtly impossible detail. The composition leaves a broad nearly empty upper water column and a calm dark lower-left area for widgets; no text, lettering, sacred imagery, worship, logos, UI, watermark, or frame.
prompt:
Create exactly one striking 16:10 landscape desktop wallpaper, preferably 2560x1600, containing a Space Ghost cameo. Space Ghost is the recognizable animated superhero: muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, red power bands. The humour is affectionate and understated; he is an out-of-place visitor who takes the occasion completely seriously. Make the visual joke readable without any explanatory text.

The viewer is a devout Christian who loves history, chivalry and the medieval Crusades. Christian subjects, wherever they appear, are depicted straight, reverently and accurately, and are never the butt of the joke. Strict limits, which override anything else in this request: never depict Space Ghost or his companions as Christ, God, the Holy Spirit, an angel, a saint, the Virgin Mary or any holy person; never give them a halo, nimbus, aureole, or any devotional attribute; never place them as the object of veneration, prayer or worship; never show them as clergy performing a sacrament or blessing. Never parody scripture, the crucifixion, the Mass, the Eucharist, baptism, prayer or any act of worship. Altars, crucifixes, icons, relics and the consecrated elements are never props or punchlines. Where a church, monastery, cathedral or sacred art appears, render it with genuine reverence and let the humour come only from Space Ghost being somewhere he plainly does not belong, behaving respectfully.

Follow the supplied medium and treatment exactly and do not default to oil painting unless the request asks for one. Preserve a spacious, quieter upper edge for a desktop panel and leave at least one calm region for desktop widgets. If a theme is supplied, follow its palette throughout; otherwise choose colours that suit the subject naturally. No user interface, words, lettering, logos, watermarks or picture frames. Deliver the actual raster image using built-in native image generation; do not substitute code, SVG or a text description.

Using popular depictions, place spaceghost in those exact poses so they're fully recognizable. Do not blaspheme Christ, spaceghost's visage isn't to be worshipped in any of these images.

Theme: The Luminous Sounding. A 16:10 landscape wallpaper rendered as a hand-built shadow-puppet diorama photographed on blackened linen: layered cut vellum, translucent mica, etched brass foil, tiny wool fibers, and theatrical backlighting create crisp silhouettes with delicate material texture. The mood is maritime, archival, uncanny, and quietly comic—an old navigational world made tactile and dimensional, interrupted by Space Ghost’s unwavering professional seriousness. Use a rare palette of abyssal ink-blue, brackish jade, smoked peach, chalk-mica white, and minute flashes of signal red; preserve deep transparent shadows and luminous edge-light rather than painterly brushwork. Set the scene in a submerged Roman harbor research chamber, with vaulted stone ruins, suspended diving bells, coral-encrusted instruments, ropes, and a calm dark water column. Space Ghost stands on a lower-right inspection gantry, recognizable in a muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, and red power bands, carefully taking measurements from a tiny ancient amphora with an enormous brass caliper while divers continue their dignified archaeological work. His cape floats slightly in the water as if this were entirely normal. No sacred figures, devotional attributes, worship, lettering, logos, UI, watermark, frame, or border. Keep the upper third broad, quiet, and low-detail for a desktop panel, with a calm shadowed lower-left region for widgets.
